# Variance report: IDB rebuild vs official Table C-1

<!-- Generated by `make variance-report` (core/reconcile.py). Don't edit. -->

Every district, circuit and the nation, FY2016–FY2025: civil cases filed, terminated and pending rebuilt from the FJC civil IDB and compared with the **latest** edition of Table C-1 that prints the figure. IDB release: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:28:04 GMT, “Cases terminated in SY 1988 through June 30, 2026 and cases pending as of June 30, 2026”.

Classification (see `core/reconcile.py`): **matched** within tolerance; **explained variance** when a quantified cause covers the gap (a restated figure the IDB matches, repeat records, undated reopenings, or snapshot drift within the allowance); otherwise **unexplained**.

| Civil cases terminated | 0.05% (min 2) | 0.5% |
| Civil cases filed | 0.5% (min 10) | 2.0% |
| Civil cases pending | 1.0% (min 25) | 3.0% |
